_comment: Edit this file to configure NullVault. Reload the page after saving — no code changes needed. See README section in index.html CONFIGURATION block for details on each field.

store.name: NullVault
store.tagline: Private distribution for PWA & TWA builds

contact._comment: This is a static site, so it CANNOT send email by itself. Point 'endpoint' at a Formspree URL (https://formspree.io/f/xxxxxxx), a Web3Forms URL (https://api.web3forms.com/submit), or your own Cloud Function URL. Leave endpoint as null to keep the form's full validation/loading/success UI while simulating the network call locally.

extraFields._comment: Extra fields merged into every submission, e.g. a Web3Forms access_key.
